scheme_name: Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT): Support For Purchase Of Instruments / Equipment
other_conditions: Applicant must be a student at one of the following institutes: Government Dance College, Shree Shree Bal Mukunda Dev Music College, Imphal Art College, Manipur University of Culture, Jawaharlal Nehru Manipur Dance Academy, or Manipur University (Dance, Music, and Fine Art Department)
Applicant must be pursuing a course in an art form
Applicant may avail the scheme benefit twice during the period of studentship with a gap of one year
benefits_summary: Reimbursement towards the purchase of instruments or equipment for eligible students
documents_required: Cover letter addressed to the Director (Art & Culture)
